messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "if the full intravenous dose was not tolerated, 25 mg is used"
set: ["if the full intravenous dose was not tolerated, 25 mg is used", "low starting dose is generally used", "catheter-tipped syringe was used to give the mixture through the tube", "if you lift the device away before the window is completely yellow, you may not get the full dose", "if 300 mg orally per day not tolerated, reduce to 150 mg once a day", "do not double up if dose is not controlling symptoms", "maintenance dose is not fixed", "lowest dose that works is used long term", "3 mg dose is not effective for glycemic control", "if a dose is missed, the missed dose should be skipped", "final dosage is 25 mg four times a day", "take the missed dose if it is within 4 days after the missed dose", "throw away any liquid medicine not used within 14 days after it was mixed at the pharmacy", "dose should be used for the shortest duration", "if the diuretic response to the initial dose is not satisfactory, the dose may be increased by 1 or 2 mg/kg", "once-daily dose may not keep blood pressure controlled for the full 24 hours"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
